snippet.title: AntonSneeze - Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD FOR FREE: https://jsmash-salted.itch.io/antonsneeze

[Made for Summitsphere's "AntonJam 2022"]

Anton caught a cold, and a strong one to bout!
It's so strong that EXPLOSIVES come out from his sneezes!

Help Anton find a cure for his dangerous illness, and destroy anything on your path...
... and why you ask?

WHO CARES! IT'S HAPPY HOUR!

Edited by: Jair the Almeida Cuomo
Music by: Tony Grayson
